Login.tagline: Every unit's report, one place, on time.
Login.taglineDescription: From Muqam to National: submit your monthly report, follow its status and download any past report.
Login.title: Sign in
Login.subtitle: Use the email your Secretariat registered for you.
Login.inviteNotice: New head? Open the invitation link in your email to set up your account. Trouble signing in? Contact your National Secretariat.
Login.checkEmailDescription: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
Login.sharedDeviceNotice: Signing in on a shared device? Don't tick "Keep me signed in".
Login.mfaChallengeDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
Login.recoveryCodeNotice: Lost your device? Enter one of your saved recovery codes instead.
Login.forgotCheckEmailDescription: If an account exists for {identifier}, we've sent a link to reset the password.
Login.forgotSubtitle: Enter the email your Secretariat registered for you and we'll send a reset link.
Login.resetDoneDescription: Your password has been reset. Sign in with your new password.
Login.resetSubtitle: Enter a new password for your account.

Mfa.enabledDescription: Your account is protected with an authenticator app.
Mfa.mandatoryNotice: Two-step sign-in is required for your role and can't be turned off.
Mfa.mandatoryForRole: Secretariat and admin accounts must use two-step sign-in.
Mfa.qrAlt: QR code for authenticator app enrollment
Mfa.scanInstructions: Scan this QR code with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or a similar app. Can't scan it? Enter the key manually.
Mfa.recoveryCodesDescription: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app.
